principles.requirement: Provenance must be distinguishable from interpretation.
UX must never imply more certainty than accepted contracts provide.
Destructive and privileged actions require explicit intent.
Hiding UI is not a security control.
Empty, loading and error states never imply safety.
Historical state must not silently become current state.
System result and human adjudication remain separate.

mental_model.meaning: Primary workspace/container for related activity; accepted lifecycle and resource authorization unchanged; no case-level verdict.
Material presented in one submission act, separate from evidence, execution and result; content-bearing context follows the evidence boundary.
Retained original material with integrity/custody provenance; metadata visibility does not grant content visibility.
A governed transform with exact parent lineage; never replaces its original; no standalone derivative API surface is available.
One governed analysis execution with its own historical context, exact input and pins.
Exact governed input consumed by exactly one Evaluation; distinct from raw evidence and never ordinary editable user content; no standalone API editor or viewer.
Immutable completed deterministic result of one Evaluation; no edit, override or aggregate case verdict.
Separate append-only human review/context of a pinned result; never overwrites that result; C4 rationale requires permission.
Report / ReportBundle revision with pinned sources; metadata and content are separate; format deferred to P7-WP5.
Reproduce/verify the historical deterministic result from exact required historical material; not current analysis.
Advisory supporting provider assertions; no TrustLens verdict and no governed-artifact consumption.
Content-free governed removal fact, where the API exposes it; distinct from ordinary not-found and never reconstruction of content.
Governed request and server-confirmed outcome; completion is not inferred from an accepted request.
Content-free routing/assignment metadata; neither a detection score nor an adjudication.
Accepted resource grant; metadata and content permission remain separate.
Explicit scoped temporary administrator privilege with reason, audit and independent post-event review.
Governed accountability metadata; ordinary activity and telemetry never substitute for it.
Authenticated caller reference from getMe; no client-authored identity authority.
Exact governed bundle reference; no application rule authoring or database knowledge authority.
Accepted activation history metadata; historical pins do not become the current active bundle.
Navigation shell only; no workload aggregate or persisted dashboard object.
Composition of permitted case metadata; not a new aggregate verdict.
Summary of already permitted resource timestamps/statuses only; no invented activity-feed API or audit authority.
Composition of permitted evaluation/report/adjudication records; no new history entity.
Presentation grouping of attributed advisory enrichment separate from the deterministic result.
Task that creates a NEW Evaluation and NEW GovernedInputArtifact under current governed conditions; never overwrites history.
UI entry to the accepted external identity boundary; no invented login API or local credential store.

surfaces.title: Session / sign-in
surfaces.scope_note: No TrustLens login operation; external OIDC boundary; browser session/CSRF choice deferred.

surfaces.title: Work overview
surfaces.scope_note: Task navigation only; no aggregate work counters or cross-case content.

surfaces.title: Cases
surfaces.scope_note: Permitted case metadata only; creating a case remains USER-only.

surfaces.title: Case workspace
surfaces.scope_note: No case verdict or free-text case-note editor; activity is permitted metadata composition.

surfaces.title: Submission detail
surfaces.scope_note: Intake details deferred to WP2; no content-bearing free text in submission metadata.

surfaces.title: Evidence metadata
surfaces.scope_note: Metadata never includes evidence bytes or storage locators.

surfaces.title: Evidence content
surfaces.scope_note: Application-mediated attachment download only; no inline raw rendering promised. ADMINISTRATOR needs accepted scoped break-glass.

surfaces.title: Evaluation history / execution
surfaces.scope_note: Status and existing API provenance only; no raw governed artifact exposure; current analysis creates a new Evaluation.

surfaces.title: Detection result
surfaces.scope_note: STANDARD requires content permission; DETAILED additionally requires assigned ANALYST; no editing.

surfaces.title: Human review history
surfaces.scope_note: Outcome/time available per case access; rationale only for assigned ANALYST with content permission; create is separately restricted.

surfaces.title: Reports / history
surfaces.scope_note: Case-scoped report metadata; no global report collection endpoint.

surfaces.title: Report generation / content
surfaces.scope_note: Derived content permission; no automatic transmission; exact pinned regeneration only.

surfaces.title: Historical verification
surfaces.scope_note: Content-free outcomes/digests; administrator can enter through an authorized reference without access to the parent case.

surfaces.title: Review queue
surfaces.scope_note: ANALYST-only content-free queue; deployment scope remains provisional under ASM-002.

surfaces.title: Review assignment
surfaces.scope_note: Administrator command for an already-authorized target reference. No administrator queue-read or principal-directory API exists; target/ETag discovery is unresolved for WP4/API owner.

surfaces.title: Audit / accountability
surfaces.scope_note: Content-free governed audit; authorized administrator read is itself audited.

surfaces.title: External supporting context
surfaces.scope_note: ANALYST-only normalized advisory metadata; attribute provider category and observed time if returned; no raw provider body or invented provider identity field.

surfaces.title: Privileged evidence access
surfaces.scope_note: Explicit reason, scope, temporary nature, audit and post-event review; no silent elevation; reviewer differs from grantee.

surfaces.title: Governed removal requests
surfaces.scope_note: Owner request and administrator decision are different actions; no optimistic completion or numeric retention.

surfaces.title: Case access administration
surfaces.scope_note: Content-free grants; owner may list, administrator may revoke; direct authorized entry does not grant parent case access.

surfaces.title: Account / role context
surfaces.scope_note: Authenticated self summary only; no credential, role-editing or account-directory operation.

surfaces.title: Knowledge provenance / history
surfaces.scope_note: Read-only permitted bundle identities and activation history; per-operation roles apply; no rule-body editing.

presentation_states.meaning: Waiting for an authorized response; no provisional verdict.
Nothing is available for this surface/query; no safety inference.
Authorized representation is available; readiness is not a verdict.
Accepted or executing work; no completion claim.
Action did not complete; preserve safe field errors without values.
Authentication boundary required.
Operation refused; no protected content or invented reason.
Use only when authorized metadata establishes the separate content-permission restriction; otherwise ACCESS_DENIED.
Preserve existence masking; do not disclose whether a hidden resource exists.
Required concurrency precondition absent.
State changed; refresh permitted state; never silently overwrite.
Material conflict; distinguish safe backend code; do not resubmit blindly.
Governed-unavailability state; 410 is distinct from ordinary 404 or empty; never recreate content.
Dependency unavailable; no safety or completion inference.
Unsupported capability, never benign; a completed UNSUPPORTED classification remains a result, not a transport failure.
Required historical material unavailable; never latest substitution; separate permitted re-analysis may create a new Evaluation.
Required pinned report source unavailable; never regenerate from latest.
Withhold unverified content; no result or safety inference.
Safe server failure; distinct from integrity failure.
Admission control; respect governed retry guidance; no invented countdown.
Configured input bound exceeded; no invented limit value.
